北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，气温 30℃。阳光正好，出门记得防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and 30℃. Enjoy the sun, but remember to hydrate and use sun protection!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪 37℃ 高温，体感 39℃。注意防暑，多喝水，小心中暑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is 37℃, feels like 39℃. Stay cool, drink plenty of water to avoid heatstroke!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海 34℃，体感 36℃。天气闷热，别忘了多补水、勤休息呀！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is 34℃, feels like 36℃. It's muggy, so remember to hydrate and rest often!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨，湿度 96%。出门带伞，路面湿滑，请慢行哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, 96% humidity. Bring an umbrella and drive carefully on wet roads!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 30℃，湿度 80%。闷热感强，及时补充水分，保持清爽！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is 30℃ with 80% humidity. It feels muggy, so hydrate and stay refreshed!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州 32℃。天气炎热，注意防暑降温，多喝水哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is 32℃. It's hot, so stay cool, drink more water, and prevent heatstroke!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云 33℃。高温持续，记得多喝水、少晒太阳哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and 33℃. High temperatures continue, remember to hydrate and avoid sun!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都 37℃ 高温，体感 39℃。注意防暑，多补水、多休息哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is 37℃, feels like 39℃. Stay cool, hydrate well, and get enough rest!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉 32℃。天气闷热，及时补水，注意防暑降温呀！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is 32℃. It's muggy, so hydrate promptly and remember to stay cool!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 37℃ 晴朗，体感 38℃。紫外线强，防晒补水不能少！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and 37℃, feels like 38℃. Strong UV, sun protection and hydration are key!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 36℃ 晴朗，体感 38℃。高温来袭，注意防晒和防暑哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and 36℃, feels like 38℃. High heat, remember sun protection and stay cool!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨小雨，湿度 98%。出门记得带伞，路面湿滑，注意慢行！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has light rain, 98% humidity. Remember your umbrella and drive carefully on wet roads!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云 28℃。天气适中，出门愉快，注意防晒哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and 28℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy your day, but remember sun protection!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云 25℃。气温宜人，早晚微凉，备件外套更舒适！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and 25℃. Pleasant temperature, slightly cool in morning/evening, bring a jacket!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云 30℃，湿度 71%。感觉闷热，记得多喝水，防中暑哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 30℃ with 71% humidity. It feels muggy, hydrate to avoid heatstroke!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，能见度低。驾车请减速慢行，注意交通安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with low visibility. Drive slowly and carefully for road safety!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云 26℃，体感 24℃。体感凉爽，外出舒适，注意防晒！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and 26℃, feels like 24℃. Enjoy the cool weather, but don't forget sun protection!
